thread:
Elena: Heads-up — I'm proposing a quick RICE sweep for Q3 backlog after the exec ask this morning.
Sam: Are we doing a full rescore or just mid-prio nudges?
Elena: Full-ish. Focus on items that have drifted since we last scored: predictive caching, dedicated autoscale, KMS rollout, and small infra QoS changes.
Mike: +1. Can we set a fast rubric: R (reach last 30d users), I (expected revenue or SLA avoidance $), C (dev days), E (risk/effort 1-5)?
Ana: I prefer keeping impact as customer-visible metrics (pages/sec, error reduction) vs vague revenue.
Elena: Agreed — let's use: Reach = users/mo, Impact = $ or SLA risk avoided (convert to $), Confidence = % , Effort = dev-weeks. We'll convert to standard RICE.
Sam: OK. Quick proposal:
```
Predictive Cache: R=150k, I=$12k, C=60%, E=8w => RICE ~ 150k*12k*0.6/8w (normalize later)
Dedicated autoscale: R=80k, I=$30k, C=50%, E=12w
KMS rollout: R=40k, I=$20k, C=70%, E=6w
Infra QoS tweaks: R=30k, I=$5k, C=80%, E=2w
```
Ana: Those raw numbers look fine for a quick pass. We should flag Predictive Cache for potential split: ship prefix-only cache first (4w) then adaptive layer (4w).
Mike: If we split, effective effort reduces and confidence goes up — likely shifts RICE a lot.
Elena: My ask: can product team recommend which items to move to 'commit' vs 'park' for the quarter? I propose commit: KMS rollout (compliance), Dedicated autoscale (sales), split commit for Predictive Cache (prefix first). Park: Infra QoS unless we find a clear customer blocker.
Sam: @Elena can you add quick notes for sales vs compliance rationale? I'll update the spreadsheet and re-run normalized RICE scores.
Elena: Added comments in the sheet. I'll ping when recalculated. Keeping this thread for any objections — please react :thumbsup: / :thumbsdown: within 12h.
prio-bot: Reminder — rescore due EOD Fri, spreadsheet link: https://go/reports/q3-prio
Ana: :thumbsup: No objections from me.
Mike: :thumbsup: fine with split on cache.
Sam: :thumbsup:
Elena: Thanks team — will close after scores are updated.
